title: swap: 3 copies vs 3 moves (slides 170–171)
expectedStdout:
copy swap: 1 copy ctor, 2 copy assign, 0 move ctor, 0 move assign, 1 allocations
move swap: 0 copy ctor, 0 copy assign, 1 move ctor, 2 move assign, 0 allocations
tryThis: Only **1** allocation for the copy-swap? `std::vector`'s copy *assignment* reuses the destination's buffer when it is big enough. Only the copy-*constructed* `tmp` allocates. It still copies 3 × 1,000,000 doubles, while the move version copies none.
Make the two vectors different sizes (`a{ 10 }`, `b{ 1'000'000 }`) and count again.
